name: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit
summary: This EA is based on the SilverTrend signal indicator combined with the ColorJFatl (Juriy Fatl) digital filter for trend confirmation. It generates buy and sell signals when the SilverTrend changes direction, confirmed by the JFatl trend color, and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop mechanisms.
summary_zh: 该EA基于SilverTrend信号指标与ColorJFatl数字滤波器进行趋势确认的组合策略。当SilverTrend改变方向且JFatl趋势颜色确认时产生买卖信号，并通过可配置的止损、止盈和移动止损机制管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于SilverTrend信号线和JFatl数字滤波器的双重确认机制，SilverTrend负责捕捉趋势转折点，JFatl滤波器负责确认趋势方向和过滤假信号。入场条件为SilverTrend指标发出趋势转向信号且ColorJFatl的颜色与信号方向一致，即做多时JFatl为上升趋势颜色，做空时为下降趋势颜色。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈水平，以及基于ATR或固定点数的移动止损跟踪机制。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和亏损保护机制，但整体风控依赖于参数配置的合理性，缺乏自适应的风险调整逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is built on a dual-confirmation mechanism using the SilverTrend signal line and the JFatl digital filter, where SilverTrend captures trend reversal points and JFatl confirms trend direction while filtering out false signals. Entry conditions require SilverTrend to issue a trend reversal signal AND the ColorJFatl indicator color to align with the signal direction — long when JFatl shows uptrend color and short when it shows downtrend color. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, plus a trailing stop mechanism based on either ATR or fixed pip distances. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides maximum position limits and loss protection features, though overall risk control depends heavily on parameter configuration quality and lacks adaptive risk adjustment logic.

parameters.description: 每次交易的资金风险比例

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 固定止损点数，0为不使用
parameters.description_en: Fixed stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 固定止盈点数，0为不使用
parameters.description_en: Fixed take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0为不使用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: CountBars
parameters.description_en: Number of historical bars for calculation

pros: 双指标确认机制有效减少假信号，提高入场准确率
SilverTrend结合数字滤波器能较好捕捉中长期趋势转折
参数化设计灵活，用户可根据不同品种和周期调整策略参数
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation mechanism effectively reduces false signals and improves entry accuracy
SilverTrend combined with digital filter captures medium-to-long-term trend reversals well
Parameterized design offers flexibility for users to adapt the strategy across different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中SilverTrend容易频繁发出假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏自适应市场状态识别机制，无法自动区分趋势和震荡行情
止损和移动止损参数依赖静态配置，在高波动市场可能无法有效保护资金
cons_en: SilverTrend frequently generates false signals during ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks adaptive market state recognition — cannot automatically distinguish between trending and ranging conditions
Stop loss and trailing stop parameters rely on static configuration, which may fail to protect capital effectively in high-volatility markets
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中自动暂停交易
引入自适应止损机制，基于ATR动态调整止损和移动止损距离
增加时间过滤和交易时段控制，避免在低流动性时段开仓
improvements_en: Add a market state filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to automatically pause trading during ranging markets
Introduce adaptive stop loss mechanism using ATR-based dynamic adjustment for both stop loss and trailing stop distances
Add time filtering and session control to avoid opening positions during low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 静态止损配置在高波动市场可能不足，存在较大滑点风险
缺乏市场状态过滤导致震荡行情中频繁开仓可能产生连续亏损
双指标滞后性可能导致入场延迟，在快速反转行情中损失加大
risk_points_en: Static stop loss configuration may be insufficient in high-volatility markets, with significant slippage risk
Lack of market state filtering leads to frequent entries during ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive losses
Dual-indicator lag may cause delayed entries, increasing losses during rapid market reversals
